Name: CP - Brighter Island Hut
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
This is my second mod changing the island hut's appearance. I really hate it and how DRAB it looks in comparison to the rest of the island.

Unlike my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8561]other mod[/url], this doesn't drastically change the hut, just makes it brighter using palettes picked from the game. This mod does not edit the ruins of the hut before you restore it.

Manifest.Name: CP - Brighter Island Hut
Manifest.Description: Uses colours from the game to make the island hut match it.
Manifest.Author: Dots
